package postgres

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/filters"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
)

// TechRepoPG implements TechRepository.
type TechRepoPG struct {
	Pool *pgxpool.Pool
}

// Create inserts tech label.
func (r TechRepoPG) Create(ctx context.Context, tech domain.Tech) error {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	_, err := runner.Exec(ctx, `INSERT INTO tech (label, created_at) VALUES ($1,$2) ON CONFLICT (label) DO NOTHING`,
		tech.Label, tech.CreatedAt)
	return err
}

// GetByLabel finds tech by label.
func (r TechRepoPG) GetByLabel(ctx context.Context, label string) (*domain.Tech, error) {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	row := runner.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT id, label, created_at FROM tech WHERE label=$1`, label)
	var t domain.Tech
	if err := row.Scan(&t.ID, &t.Label, &t.CreatedAt); err != nil {
		if err == pgx.ErrNoRows {
			return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
		}
		return nil, err
	}
	return &t, nil
}

// GetByID finds tech by id.
func (r TechRepoPG) GetByID(ctx context.Context, id int) (*domain.Tech, error) {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	row := runner.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT id, label, created_at FROM tech WHERE id=$1`, id)
	var t domain.Tech
	if err := row.Scan(&t.ID, &t.Label, &t.CreatedAt); err != nil {
		if err == pgx.ErrNoRows {
			return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
		}
		return nil, err
	}
	return &t, nil
}

// Update updates tech label.
func (r TechRepoPG) Update(ctx context.Context, tech domain.Tech) error {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	cmd, err := runner.Exec(ctx, `UPDATE tech SET label=$1 WHERE id=$2`, tech.Label, tech.ID)
	if err != nil {
		return mapPgError(err)
	}
	if cmd.RowsAffected() == 0 {
		return domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	return nil
}

// Delete removes tech by id.
func (r TechRepoPG) Delete(ctx context.Context, id int) error {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	cmd, err := runner.Exec(ctx, `DELETE FROM tech WHERE id=$1`, id)
	if err != nil {
		return mapPgError(err)
	}
	if cmd.RowsAffected() == 0 {
		return domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	return nil
}

// List returns tech list with pagination.
func (r TechRepoPG) List(ctx context.Context, filter filters.TechFilters) ([]domain.Tech, int, error) {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	_, limit, offset := filters.NormalizePagination(filter.Page, filter.Limit)

	whereClause := ""
	args := []any{}
	argIdx := 1
	if filter.Query != nil && *filter.Query != "" {
		whereClause = "WHERE label ILIKE $" + fmt.Sprint(argIdx)
		args = append(args, "%"+*filter.Query+"%")
		argIdx++
	}

	var total int
	countQuery := "SELECT count(*) FROM tech " + whereClause
	if err := runner.QueryRow(ctx, countQuery, args...).Scan(&total); err != nil {
		return nil, 0, err
	}
	query := "SELECT id, label, created_at FROM tech " + whereClause + " ORDER BY label ASC LIMIT $" + fmt.Sprint(argIdx) + " OFFSET $" + fmt.Sprint(argIdx+1)
	args = append(args, limit, offset)
	rows, err := runner.Query(ctx, query, args...)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, 0, err
	}
	defer rows.Close()
	var techs []domain.Tech
	for rows.Next() {
		var t domain.Tech
		if err := rows.Scan(&t.ID, &t.Label, &t.CreatedAt); err != nil {
			return nil, 0, err
		}
		techs = append(techs, t)
	}
	if err := rows.Err(); err != nil {
		return nil, 0, err
	}
	return techs, total, nil
}

var _ repository.TechRepository = (*TechRepoPG)(nil)
